input_payload: According to the report, net income attributable to Pfizer Inc. common shareholders for Pfizer Inc. in 2019 was $16026M. According to the report, gain on completion of Consumer Healthcare JV transaction for Pfizer Inc. in 2019 was $8107M.
handoff_payload:
# Analysis

Based on the extracted information, yes, there was a significant non-operational event that substantially increased Pfizer's net income in 2019.

The gain on completion of the Consumer Healthcare joint venture transaction totaled $8,107 million in 2019. This represents approximately 50.6% of the total net income attributable to common shareholders of $16,026 million for that year.

This Consumer Healthcare JV transaction gain is a one-time event outside of Pfizer's standard business operations, as it relates to the completion and accounting treatment of a joint venture transaction rather than ongoing pharmaceutical sales, research, or core business activities. Without this gain, the underlying net income from standard operations would have been substantially lower at approximately $7,919 million.

Therefore, this non-operational event materially inflated 2019 net income by more than half.
